SafeMath.safeAdd: c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow check.
SafeMath.safeSub: require(b <= a); c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul: c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv: require(b > 0); c = a / b.

edges.reason: owner is initialized from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender]; caller identity controls whose balance is spent.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], caller identity defines spender allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval call.
safeAdd computes c = a + b, the unchecked-at-EVM-level addition site.
safeSub computes c = a - b, potential underflow site.
safeMul computes c = a * b, potential overflow site.
safeDiv computes c = a / b.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)], a subtraction without explicit guard.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer calls safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens).
transfer calls safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
transfer writes the balances mapping for msg.sender and recipient.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
transferFrom writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval after writing allowance state.
The external call executes the callee's receiveApproval, giving the untrusted contract control flow.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on the caller-supplied token address.
